abstract: Give AI agents least-privilege, auditable access in a ScaleDock product: PermDock decides every tool call, delegation and human approval across the AI SDK, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Eve, MCP, A2A, WebMCP, AG-UI and AP2, Web Bot Auth fills the actor for HTTP bots, and decisions are recorded through OpenTelemetry GenAI spans and OCSF for EU AI Act record-keeping. It installs the matching spec skills and defers to them on protocol details; references/stack.md maps each one onto PermDock.
